import copy
import unittest
from solution import overlay_rows


class OverlayRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_replace_preserves_base_order_and_appends_new_updates(self):
        base = [{"id": "a", "x": 1}, {"id": "b", "x": 2}, {"id": "c", "x": 3}]
        updates = [{"id": "b", "y": [20]}, {"id": "d", "x": 4}, {"id": "a", "x": 10}]
        self.assertEqual(overlay_rows(base, updates, "replace"), [
            {"id": "a", "x": 10},
            {"id": "b", "y": [20]},
            {"id": "c", "x": 3},
            {"id": "d", "x": 4},
        ])

    def test_merge_update_fields_win_and_id_is_retained(self):
        base = [{"id": "a", "x": 1, "same": "base"}]
        updates = [{"id": "a", "x": 9, "same": "update", "new": 2}]
        self.assertEqual(overlay_rows(base, updates, "merge"), [
            {"id": "a", "x": 9, "same": "update", "new": 2}
        ])

    def test_deep_copy_nonmutation_and_no_cross_row_alias(self):
        shared = {"items": [1]}
        base = [{"id": "a", "data": shared}, {"id": "b", "data": shared}]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(base)
        result = overlay_rows(base, [], "merge")
        self.assertEqual(base, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], base[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["data"], base[0]["data"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["data"], result[1]["data"])
        result[0]["data"]["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(base, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["data"]["items"], [1])

    def test_empty_lists_return_fresh_list(self):
        base = []
        result = overlay_rows(base, [], "replace")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, base)

    def test_invalid_top_level_values(self):
        for rows in (None, (), {}):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                overlay_rows(rows, [], "merge")
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                overlay_rows([], rows, "merge")
        for mode in (None, 1, True):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                overlay_rows([], [], mode)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            overlay_rows([], [], "append")

    def test_invalid_rows_ids_and_duplicates(self):
        for row in (None, [], "x"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                overlay_rows([row], [], "replace")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            overlay_rows([{"x": 1}], [], "replace")
        for bad_id in (1, None, True):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                overlay_rows([{"id": bad_id}], [], "replace")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            overlay_rows([{"id": "a"}, {"id": "a"}], [], "replace")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            overlay_rows([], [{"id": "a"}, {"id": "a"}], "replace")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
